headline: Brent Crude Trades Near $115 as Maritime Attacks Risk Crude Supply
summary: Brent crude prices held near $115 per barrel following over 30 maritime security incidents recorded in the Strait of Hormuz over the past month amid rising regional hostilities.
why: Brent Crude is the primary pricing benchmark for international oil trade, sensitive to supply disruptions in key Middle Eastern transit corridors.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz increase risk premiums on crude oil shipments.

why_moved: Crude prices remained elevated due to persistent risk premiums stemming from potential supply blockades and tanker disruptions in key Middle East choke points.
